== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 16 August 2012. The Facebook photo viewer names Jeff Weitkamp. The caption names Kim Weitkamp as the photographer. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 40 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Hazelwood, Mo). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/jeff.weitkamp.5 (Lives in Richmond, Virginia; Hazelwood West High School, Hazelwood, Missouri).
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Jeff Weitkamp portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Jeff Weitkamp Facebook portrait.jpg]].
